intro: Below are different measures of each group member's participation in this Telar site. Each measures something different, and none capture the full complexity of working on a Telar project as a team. None of these numbers should be taken as a score or ranking. And please note that work done outside of the Compositor — reading, thinking, planning, and drafting — is not reflected here at all.

made.heading: What was made
made.subhead: Three measures of the content itself, counted for each kind of thing in the site.

definitions.added: How many things each person made.
definitions.edited: How many things each person wrote in. On a team these are often different people. Something added and left empty does not count here.
definitions.words: Length, not quality. Counted separately for each kind of writing, because writing a step answer is not the same work as writing a panel, an object record, a page or a glossary definition. Rewriting a passage adds those words again.

legend: bars show each person's share of the group's; the table has the counts
predatesCollection: This project existed before these measures were collected. Steps added and edited have been counted; words and time are recorded as the work happens from now on, and start at zero.

time.heading: Time in the Compositor
time.caveat: How long each person has spent working inside the Compositor. Editing counts any change to the site: writing, framing an image, adding a step, reordering, filling in a record. Writing is the part of that time spent typing text. The clock starts on a change and stops after a minute, unless a new change is detected.
